query:
SELECT skill_pid, worker_pid, proficiency
         FROM worker_skills
         WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
           AND skill_pid = ANY($1)
           AND proficiency >= $2
           AND worker_pid IN (
               SELECT pid FROM workers
               WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
                 AND hired_on <= $3
                 AND (terminated_on IS NULL OR terminated_on > $3)
                 AND ($4::text[] IS NULL OR organization_ref = ANY($4))
           )
